metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · Punjab '95
metas.description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Sirf Ek Bandaa Kaafi Hai
metas.description: A common man with honesty and integrity can take on the system when he has truth on his side.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · Gangubai Kathiawadi
metas.description: Duped and sold to a brothel, a young woman fearlessly reclaims her power, using underworld connections to preside over the world she was once a pawn in.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · Kill
metas.description: During a train trip to New Delhi, a pair of commandos face an army of invading bandits.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Monica, O My Darling
metas.description: A slick robotics expert joins a murderous plot after a passionate affair takes a sudden turn, but nothing not even death , is what it seems to be.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · Chor Nikal Ke Bhaga
metas.description: A flight attendant and her business partner on a mission to steal diamonds and free themselves from the clutches of a loan shark.At 40,000 feet in the air, the heist goes horribly wrong and turns into a hostage situation.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Vikram Vedha
metas.description: A tough police officer sets out to track down and kill an equally tough gangster.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Sector 36
metas.description: A fictional story Inspired by true events, several children go missing from a basti (slum) in Sector 36. A determined police officer must now face off with a cunning serial killer as a chilling investigation and dark secrets unfold.
